subject: writing-blog-posts

compared.with: the working tree: cuts take whole sentences, clauses or phrases and keep every surviving word as written; the editor's report opens on the diagnosis, lists changes by impact, and gives no reason that only sounds meaningful

claude.version: Claude Code, subagents reading the deployed skill

method: Scratch folders outside the repository, skill deployed with scripts/deploy.sh. Kept-word share is the in-order word match of the edited body against the original body (difflib). Dead-end phrases checked by a fixed pattern list over the reply.
notes: Both arms hit two thirds and kept every number. Without the skill both runs reworded surviving sentences and dropped the owner's closing 'lol'; with it both runs cut only, kept every surviving word, and asked before losing the line they were least sure about.
